import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    n = p[6]
    return a + b*eps**n + p[7]*eps + p[8]*eps**2 + p[9]*np.log(eps)
